title: The Days of Creation
description: Test your knowledge of God's creation week from Genesis 1-2!

questions.question: What did God create on Day 1?
questions.explanation: God created light on Day 1 and separated it from darkness (Genesis 1:3-5).

questions.question: What did God create on Day 2?
questions.explanation: God created the sky (expanse/firmament) on Day 2, separating the waters above from the waters below (Genesis 1:6-8).

questions.question: What did God create on Day 3?
questions.explanation: God created dry land, seas, and all vegetation on Day 3 (Genesis 1:9-13).

questions.question: What did God create on Day 4?
questions.explanation: God created the sun, moon, and stars on Day 4 to govern day and night and to mark seasons (Genesis 1:14-19).

questions.question: What did God create on Day 5?
questions.explanation: God created all sea creatures and birds on Day 5 (Genesis 1:20-23).

questions.question: What makes humans special compared to the rest of creation?
options: Humans were made in God's image
questions.explanation: Humans are uniquely made in God's image, meaning we can think, love, create, and have a relationship with God (Genesis 1:27).

questions.question: Why did God rest on Day 7?
options: He was tired from all the work
He ran out of things to create
To set an example and make the day holy
questions.explanation: God rested on Day 7 not because He was tired, but to bless the day, make it holy, and set an example of rest for us (Genesis 2:2-3).

questions.question: According to Genesis 1:11, plants were created to reproduce how?
options: By evolving over millions of years
By changing into new types of plants
questions.explanation: God designed each plant to produce seeds 'according to its kind' — apple trees always produce apples, oak trees always produce acorns (Genesis 1:11).

questions.question: How many days did it take God to create everything?
questions.explanation: God created everything in 6 days and rested on the 7th day (Genesis 2:1-3). Creation was complete in six literal days.

questions.question: What did God say when He looked at everything He had made?
questions.explanation: After creating mankind on Day 6, God looked at all He had made and declared it 'very good' (Genesis 1:31).
